decisions.reason: As a newly launched Magento-specific template with low carrying cost, it is still a relatively cheap option to keep open while the firm learns more about demand.

This responsive website template appears to be a less prominently backed offering, but because digital templates are inexpensive to maintain, management would likely keep it on the market a bit longer before abandoning it.

Premium customer support can complement the firm's core services and its value is still uncertain after only a short time, so the firm would likely continue offering it unless uptake proves clearly weak.
Being presented on its own page suggests a stronger commitment and clearer strategic fit, so the firm is likely to preserve this software tool while uncertainty about its long-term value resolves.

The standalone presentation indicates meaningful initial investment, and although compliance tools can be somewhat opportunity-driven, the product is still young enough that keeping the option open is sensible.
